mechanism: Fentanyl-induced respiratory depression can lead to hypercapnia and acidosis, which may shift potassium intracellularly and mask hyperkalemia or cause electrolyte imbalances; potassium supplementation requires careful monitoring in patients receiving opioids.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and acid-base status in patients receiving concurrent fentanyl and potassium supplementation, particularly those with renal impairment or respiratory compromise.
